Instrument sounds in Stand

violin, viola, cellosec, bass, strings, tremolo, pizz, flute, oboe, clarinet, bassoon, piccolo,
horn, trumpet, trombone, tuba, harp, glockenspiel, marimba, xylophone:
  VS Chamber Orchestra: Community Edition (VSCO-2-CE) by Versilian Studios — CC0 1.0 (public domain)
  https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE

piano:
  Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm — CC BY 3.0
  https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3

cello (solo):
  "Real cello notes" by flcellogrl, Freesound pack 12408, via tonejs-instruments — CC BY 3.0
  https://freesound.org  ·  https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments

all other instruments:
  MusyngKite soundfont (as before).

Samples were trimmed, loudness-matched, looped and encoded for Stand.
